record.oneLiner: Atlas Administration API for managing Atlas projects, clusters and access, with an official MongoDB MCP Server that can also run Atlas tools.
record.verdictReason: Service account OAuth tokens and HTTP Digest API keys are both documented, and an Atlas account is the only stated prerequisite beyond Organization Owner role. The API lists many resource endpoints, so breadth is broad.
